VARIANT 01 HUG ARCH: a continuous wide rounded U arch grows naturally from two ends of a broad low oval base. A small round Pebble Buddy face and fabric speaker torso is integrated into the LEFT upright, with the arch sweeping from behind its head across the workbook. Expressive fins sit on the torso. The central working area beneath the arch remains open, wide and usable. One integrated base contains the foam feedback outlet at right and a central phone slot. Compact friendly desk appliance; arch is not a detached lamp.
